purpose: Resolve every stochastic and numerical detail left open by the parent V70 program before the fixed fit completes, then decide from excluded train-only mechanism objects whether V70 learned cross-domain joint spatial structure without a pair or Fourier training loss.

parent_evidence.required_optimizer_step_before_this_free: the already-running byte-bound fixed V70 fit only; no checkpoint or loss result has been inspected to define this gate

noise_streams.mapping: For each stream, draw one sequential torch CUDA standard-normal tensor in domain, query-list, and member order. The identical tensor is the EDM initial innovation and the paired independent-voxel V63 baseline latent. No seed may be selected or repeated after seeing a metric.

sampler.schedule: 40 values linearly spaced in sigma^(1/rho) from sigma_maximum to sigma_minimum, raised to rho, followed by an exact terminal zero
sampler.initial_state: sigma_maximum times the frozen standard-normal innovation
sampler.update: Euler probability-flow update at every interval and the standard second-order Heun correction whenever the next sigma is nonzero
sampler.candidate_inverse: Phi(candidate z) through the frozen query-local V63 bounded inverse
sampler.baseline_inverse: Phi(the paired independent standard-normal innovation) through the identical V63 inverse
sampler.post_inverse: undo V63 target standardization, subtract each residual cube mean once in float64, and add the unchanged query backbone

fourier_measurement.window: the unchanged separable 64-cell Hann window from hong2021_residual_evaluate.SpectralBinner
fourier_measurement.DC: subtract each full log-density or residual field cube mean before windowing
fourier_measurement.total_power: average the Hann-windowed full log-density |rfftn|^2 over all queries and members before dividing by the corresponding averaged truth power and mode-weighting within each band
fourier_measurement.phase_sensitive_energy_score: on the complex Hann-windowed full-band residual rfftn coefficients restricted to one band, mean_m ||F_m-F_truth||_2/sqrt(N_modes) minus 0.5 times mean over ordered m!=n of ||F_m-F_n||_2/sqrt(N_modes); average object scores arithmetically within each domain
fourier_measurement.baseline: the paired independent-voxel V63 marginal samples; candidate energy score must be strictly smaller, so any gain requires learned joint phase-amplitude structure rather than one-point calibration

one_point_measurement.latent: pool all generated or exact cached z voxels across the sixteen queries within each domain and stream
one_point_measurement.physical_moment: within backbone plus target_mean at or above the source q99.9 boundary, mean of (10^(4.5*y_full)-1)^2 over queries, members, and selected voxels divided by the exact truth value

selection_rules.one_point_pass: every domain and stream passes all three frozen one-point requirements
selection_rules.spectral_pass: every domain, stream, and band total-power candidate-over-truth ratio is in [0.8,1.25]
selection_rules.phase_sensitive_pass: every domain, stream, and band candidate Fourier energy score is strictly lower than its paired independent-voxel V63 baseline
selection_rules.stream_reproducibility: for every domain and band, absolute ln(stream-A/stream-B) is at most ln(1.15) separately for positive candidate energy scores and total-power ratios
selection_rules.numerical_pass: all samples and metrics are finite, maximum bounded inverse-CDF error is at most 2e-6, every exact DC residual is at most 1e-7, and peak Ada allocation is below 28 GiB
selection_rules.select_V70_for_locked_development: all one-point, spectral, phase-sensitive, stream-reproducibility, numerical, ancestry, and firewall rules pass without threshold changes
